shots.visual: Camera fast push-in on the young man slouching sadly beside a tall measuring scale. Fast whoosh SFX.
shots.vo: You'll never hit your peak height if you sleep in the wrong position.

shots.visual: Cut to the young man lying twisted on his stomach on a bed, an exaggerated cartoon spine overlay twisting awkwardly. Strain snap SFX.
shots.vo: Sleeping on your stomach or curled on your side crushes your spine all night.

shots.visual: Camera tilts down as the character stands hunched over while an arrow pulls downward against a height marker. Heavy thud SFX.
shots.vo: It stops spinal decompression and robs you of your natural growth potential.

shots.visual: Bed view, character rests flat in a neutral supine position; a bright mint green glowing spine overlay expands and elongates. Shimmer chime SFX.
shots.vo: There's an exact spinal decompression alignment to unlock maximum length overnight.

shots.visual: Whip pan to the character standing, excitedly pointing downward toward the bottom screen. Fast swoosh SFX.
shots.vo: Drop your current height in the comments right now.

shots.visual: Character sits in the lower third looking upward with an eager thumbs-up; upper frame remains open. Gentle mint glow pulse SFX.
shots.vo: Unlock the complete nighttime routine in TallPlan.
